name: Tokyo Mart
description: Tokyo Mart is your one-stop shop for footwear, bags, electronics, clothing, and fitness gear. Powered by an AI sales assistant.

policies.shipping: Free shipping on all orders above ₹999. Standard delivery takes 3–5 business days. Express delivery (1–2 days) available for ₹99 extra. Same-day delivery available in select metro cities.
policies.returns: Easy 30-day returns on all products. Items must be unused and in original packaging. Return shipping is free. Refunds processed within 5–7 business days.
policies.exchange: Free size and color exchange within 15 days of delivery. No questions asked. We'll arrange a pickup and deliver your replacement within 3 days.
policies.warranty: All electronics come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Clothing and footwear have a 6-month warranty against manufacturing defects. Bags carry a 3-month warranty.
policies.payment: We accept UPI (all apps), credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay), net banking, and EMI options starting at 0% on select cards. Cash on Delivery available for orders under ₹5000.
